_comment: The same payload as docs/compat/v4.json, published as ONE document that names the builds it applies to. v4.json is reached by the product version's first segment, and under the product scheme that segment is a release line rather than a compatibility major, so a product build cannot reach it at all. This file is reached by name. The per-major files stay for builds that read them.

entries.notes: 3.8.0 review (2026-09-14 UTC): current PSP source at 06073ca plus the negative-subSortIndex preservation fix was live-verified against fresh upstream tag 837addf and official Xray 26.9.9 on darwin/arm64. The live surface, IP/HWID limits, REALITY scan, seeded-counter traffic-floor matrix and supplemental negative-rank/shared-client checks passed. This fix is absent from published v4.0.0-beta.1..beta.8; the v3 release renderer also lacks the current REALITY ML-KEM adaptation. Keep the published 3.7.0 ceiling unchanged rather than applying current-source evidence to unpatched binaries. Numeric manifest matching does not distinguish v4.0.0 prereleases. See docs/3xui-compat.md for the verification scope and upgrade advisory. Initial v4 range inherits the existing v3.9.2-line adapter contract, not a new live-panel run of the v4 release binary. The compiled 3.4.2 floor remains necessary for POST /panel/api/server/scanRealityTargets; the 3.7.0 ceiling comes from the live PSP-adapter verification recorded in v3.json (shared-client, inbound, status and REALITY paths). Current source and request-shape tests retain that surface, including explicit panel-renewal-off fields and PSP-owned HWID limits. Register 3X-UI 3.7.0 with an admin-scoped API token; monitor/node-sync scopes do not cover PSP's API surface. Adopted hand-made finalmask inbounds may require re-saving after the upstream 3.6.0 migration. Panel/core upgrade endpoints were checked for route presence in the recorded verification, not executed. This manifest does not certify PN remote upgrades, traffic/quota end-to-end behaviour, or rollback of a migrated PSP database. Add a narrower entry first if a later v4 adapter changes its required contract.

sui_entries.notes: S-UI 1.6.3 live adapter verification (2026-09-16 UTC) used PSP main at 2440112 against tag 13abbdc4 and sing-box 1.14.1 on darwin/arm64, upgrading the existing 1.6.2 scratch database. TestLive_SUISurface passed: Token authentication, status, inbound/client read-write and cleanup remained compatible. Source review found only additive session endpoints and Snell multi-user support on the PSP-facing API; the reset-traffic fix is internal to S-UI. No production adapter changes were required. This does not certify full proxy traffic/quota enforcement or every historical PSP beta binary. No minimum S-UI version or additional optional capability is published.

3.5.0.text: 升级 3X-UI 到 3.5.0 会同时升级内置 Xray-core 到 v26.7.11 并重启内核。上游拒绝同时启用 Final Mask 与 REALITY 的 inbound；MTProto 会迁移到多客户端模型，且 tg:// 链接不再携带 remark。另有流量计数修复与 inbound 端口旧 UNIQUE 约束移除。PSP 适配器兼容依据沿用 v3 清单的既有验证记录，不代表对 V4 发布二进制另做实机验证。

3.6.0.text: 升级 3X-UI 到 3.6.0 会同时升级内置 Xray-core 到 v26.7.28 并重启内核。手工配置过 finalmask 的 inbound 请注意：XMC 格式从 usernames 改为 profiles，旧掩码需手工更新；REALITY inbound 的 finalmask.tcp 会被开机迁移删除。若该 inbound 已被 PSP 接管，旧配置快照可能持续 pending，请在 PSP 节点编辑器中重新保存；订阅只读 finalmask.udp，不受这处删除影响。PSP 自己创建的节点不受上述手工配置迁移影响。兼容依据是 v3 清单记录的既有适配器验证，而非 V4 发布二进制新实测。

3.7.0.text: 3X-UI 3.7.0 内置 Xray-core 仍锁定 3.6.0 的 commit（5ca6f4b / v26.7.28）。给 PSP 新建 API token 时必须使用 admin scope；monitor 和 node-sync scope 覆盖不了 PSP 的接口。旧 token 的空 scope 会由上游迁移补为 admin。不要在 3X-UI 中为 PSP 管理的客户端设置面板侧自动续期或流量重置周期：PSP 会主动关闭 resetDay/resetMax/trafficReset/trafficResetDay，避免面板改写 PSP 的到期与流量账本。HWID 上限 limitHwid 由 PSP 管理，应在 PSP 用户编辑界面设置，PSP 会覆盖面板侧改动；非 PSP 管理的客户端不受影响。兼容上限沿用 v3 清单记录的既有 3.7.0 适配器实机验证，并非 V4 发布二进制新实测。

3.8.0.text: 3X-UI 3.8.0 会升级内置 Xray-core 到 26.9.9、重启内核，并迁移全局 Xray 模板中的 outbound/DNS 配置。PSP 当前源码已有 REALITY ML-KEM-first 适配：Mihomo 订阅使用 chrome 指纹及 support-x25519mlkem768，请使用支持这些选项的客户端并刷新订阅；sing-box 输出会省略受影响的 REALITY 节点。已发布 PSP v4.0.0-beta.1–beta.8 编辑负数 subSortIndex 时仍会将排序重置为 1，需使用包含本次修复的 PSP 构建；当前源码实机验证不代表旧发布版本已修复，兼容上限暂保持 3.7.0。新增 TUIC sidecar、AmneziaWG 等功能不属于 PSP 已支持的 3X-UI 功能。

3.8.5.text: 3X-UI 3.8.5 是 3.8.0 系列的修复版，内置 Xray-core 仍为 26.9.9。PSP 已在真实 3.8.5 面板上验证状态、入站、共享客户端、连接上限及 REALITY 扫描，无需新增适配器代码。请使用 PSP v4.0.0-beta.9 或更新版本；beta.1–beta.8 不保留负数 subSortIndex，仍只认证到 3X-UI 3.7.0。升级跨过 3.8.0 时仍会重启内核并执行全局 Xray 模板迁移；PSP 不支持 3X-UI 新增的原生 TUIC sidecar。
